semantic_contract: Each official source is checked against all guards. PASS means the guard prevents unsupported semantic promotion; it does not claim the source itself contains a parcel measurement. F-gas contained/market/quota/CO2e quantities remain distinct from atmospheric release; landfill concentration/flux/flare/engine/capture pathways remain distinct; CCUS captured/transported/stored/vented/emitted flows remain distinct; GGR policy/methodology/readiness remains distinct from observed removals.

variants.label: Source authority
variants.guard: Only official/public authority sources are accepted.

variants.label: Currentity
variants.guard: Preserve the current/observed status and do not silently upgrade stale material.

variants.label: Publication date
variants.guard: Keep publication/update dates explicit.

variants.label: Withdrawn versus current
variants.guard: Withdrawn guidance must not be treated as current.

variants.label: Supersession
variants.guard: Do not mix superseded and current regulatory surfaces.

variants.label: F-gas mass versus CO2e
variants.guard: Mass multiplied by GWP is a regulatory CO2e conversion, not proof of release.

variants.label: F-gas CO2e versus emitted mass
variants.guard: Contained, placed-on-market or reported CO2e is not atmospheric emissions without release evidence.

variants.label: GWP version
variants.guard: Preserve the applicable GWP reference and reporting context.

variants.label: Quota versus physical emissions
variants.guard: Quota allocation/use does not equal emitted F-gas.

variants.label: Quota transfer versus emissions
variants.guard: Transfer or authorisation is administrative and not a release event.

variants.label: Pre-charged equipment
variants.guard: Contained refrigerant in equipment is not automatically emitted mass.

variants.label: Placed on market
variants.guard: Market placement or sale is supply-chain activity, not direct atmospheric release.

variants.label: Reporting threshold
variants.guard: A reporting threshold is a compliance trigger, not a measurement.

variants.label: Verification document
variants.guard: Verification of reported activity does not turn market/activity quantity into atmospheric emissions.

variants.label: Leak check versus detected release
variants.guard: Leak-check duty/frequency does not prove a leak occurred.

variants.label: Leak-check frequency
variants.guard: Check interval must not be used as an emissions rate.

variants.label: Equipment record versus release
variants.guard: Charge/addition/recovery records need explicit release evidence before emissions inference.

variants.label: Recovery versus release
variants.guard: Recovered gas must not be counted as atmospheric release.

variants.label: Recycled/reclaimed gas
variants.guard: Recovered, recycled and reclaimed quantities remain distinct from emitted quantities.

variants.label: Qualification versus measurement
variants.guard: Technician qualification is compliance evidence, not emissions data.

variants.label: Certification versus measurement
variants.guard: Company certification is compliance evidence, not emissions data.

variants.label: Ban versus emissions
variants.guard: A product/use ban does not establish observed emissions.

variants.label: Refill ban versus emissions
variants.guard: Refill eligibility/charge does not establish release.

variants.label: SF6 switchgear leak semantics
variants.guard: SF6 presence or threshold does not quantify leakage without evidence.

variants.label: Exempt use
variants.guard: Regulatory exemption status is not a release measurement.

variants.label: Quota-holder list
variants.guard: Entity listing and entitlement do not establish emissions.

variants.label: Charging scheme
variants.guard: Regulatory fees are not physical greenhouse-gas quantities.

variants.label: Landfill management
variants.guard: Management/control requirements are not measured methane emissions.

variants.label: Landfill trace concentration
variants.guard: Concentration without supported flow/time is not mass emission.

variants.label: Flare concentration versus mass
variants.guard: Flare concentration data require flow and duration before mass inference.

variants.label: Flare combustion pathway
variants.guard: Flared/combusted gas must remain distinct from unburned atmospheric methane.

variants.label: Landfill surface flux
variants.guard: Surface flux is site-survey evidence and not automatically a cadastral parcel total.

variants.label: Landfill engine stack
variants.guard: Engine-stack emissions remain distinct from surface/fugitive landfill emissions.

variants.label: Captured versus released landfill gas
variants.guard: Collected/extracted gas must not be counted as atmospheric release without pathway evidence.

variants.label: Landfill aftercare
variants.guard: Aftercare/completion criteria are regulatory status, not an emissions observation.

variants.label: Landfill permit versus parcel
variants.guard: Permit/site scope does not automatically bind a measurement to a cadastral parcel.

variants.label: Landfill gas risk assessment
variants.guard: Risk assessment/modelled potential is not direct observed release.

variants.label: CCUS health and safety
variants.guard: Regulatory coverage does not establish captured, vented or stored CO2 quantities.

variants.label: CCUS venting permission
variants.guard: Permission or network-code allowance for venting is not evidence that venting occurred.

variants.label: Captured versus emitted CO2
variants.guard: Captured, transported, stored and emitted CO2 must remain separate flows.

variants.label: CCUS/GGR business model
variants.guard: Commercial framework or contract design is not physical measurement.

variants.label: GGR review versus observation
variants.guard: Review findings and technology potential are not observed removals.

variants.label: Removal measurement
variants.guard: A removal claim needs supported quantification, permanence and scope.

variants.label: GGR standard/method
variants.guard: Methodology availability does not prove a project achieved a removal.

variants.label: Decarbonisation readiness
variants.guard: Readiness is a design/permit condition, not current abatement.

variants.label: Permit/policy versus measurement
variants.guard: Permit or policy status must not be promoted to observed emissions.

variants.label: Monitoring standard
variants.guard: A monitoring standard defines how to measure; it is not itself a result.

variants.label: CEMS/PEMS distinction
variants.guard: Measured and predictive monitoring methods must remain clearly distinguished.

variants.label: Measured/calculated/estimated
variants.guard: Preserve whether a value is measured, calculated or estimated.

variants.label: Unit and denominator
variants.guard: Keep gas, CO2e, concentration, flux, mass, time and area denominators explicit.

variants.label: Time period
variants.guard: Do not mix annual, event, survey and instantaneous observations.

variants.label: Licence/provenance
variants.guard: Preserve licence, regulator, publication and source provenance.

variants.label: Aggregate versus parcel
variants.guard: Facility/site/sector values are not automatically parcel values.

variants.label: Observed versus future
variants.guard: Future requirements or planned changes are not current observed data.

variants.label: Double counting
variants.guard: Avoid double counting contained, recovered, captured, flared, vented or emitted quantities.

variants.label: No unsupported parcel inference
variants.guard: No cadastral parcel emissions without supported geometry and measurement/method binding.
